title: alyssum gallaecicum
intro: Alyssum gallaecicum, commonly known as Galician alyssum, is a flowering plant species in the family Brassicaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to have various health benefits, including its potential in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Alyssum gallaecicum include its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, making it useful in managing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
